about: Pole runs: each big-fish wave the director picks what is running under the water. mix = how common each fish group is below (x its normal weight). stray = share of medium and big fish that will also go for a smaller bait than their own (the stray rows in strays). bank = the pole bank this run needs before the director may pick it (the bigger runs swing more). w = how often it is picked; season = each season's favorites; repeat = weight for the same run twice in a row. Show only: every bite table stays fixed, and each bait's rows pay about the same, so payback holds while the catch changes.

strays.about: Which bigger fish can take a smaller bait. Each stray row pays the fish's own pay table; its take chance is set so the row returns target of the bait's price, like the bait's other rows.

depth.about: Line depth: Shallow, Mid, Deep. Each fish lives at a depth (by group, with per-fish exceptions). A bait at a depth draws the fish that live there; near[1] = share of fish one depth away that still come up or down to it, near[2] = two depths away. bait = where each bait tier sits until the player moves the line (Lock button in pole mode). wait = a quiet bait waits this many times longer before a visitor rises at each depth. Show only: which fish come, never the bite tables.
